subject: Copy and compress data files
description:
## Task: Copy and compress data files to scripts/slop-score/data/

### Context
Read `scripts/slop-score/prompt.md` for full project context.

### Prerequisites
- Task #1 (project structure) must be complete

### What to do
1. Compress the large human_writing_profile.json (73MB → ~7MB):
```bash
gzip -c data/human_writing_profile.json > scripts/slop-score/data/human_writing_profile.json.gz
```

2. Copy the other data files:
```bash
cp data/large_en.msgpack.gz scripts/slop-score/data/
cp data/slop_list.json scripts/slop-score/data/
cp data/slop_list_bigrams.json scripts/slop-score/data/
cp data/slop_list_trigrams.json scripts/slop-score/data/
```

### Files to create
| Target File | Source | Action |
|-------------|--------|--------|
| `scripts/slop-score/data/human_writing_profile.json.gz` | `data/human_writing_profile.json` | gzip compress |
| `scripts/slop-score/data/large_en.msgpack.gz` | `data/large_en.msgpack.gz` | copy |
| `scripts/slop-score/data/slop_list.json` | `data/slop_list.json` | copy |
| `scripts/slop-score/data/slop_list_bigrams.json` | `data/slop_list_bigrams.json` | copy |
| `scripts/slop-score/data/slop_list_trigrams.json` | `data/slop_list_trigrams.json` | copy |

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 5 data files exist in `scripts/slop-score/data/`
- [ ] `human_writing_profile.json.gz` is under 10MB
- [ ] `large_en.msgpack.gz` is ~1.4MB
- [ ] JSON files are valid (can be parsed)
